verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own homepage and docs landing page both claim SDKs are available ('comprehensive SDKs', 'Integrate faster with SDKs and code samples'), so the product does claim this capability. The evidence is limited to these marketing-level mentions, with no detail on which SDKs exist or how to use them. missing for 10: named SDK languages and packages, SDK reference documentation or install instructions, evidence of maintenance or version status, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Get up and running in under an hour with our easy-to-use API, comprehensive SDKs, and expert support.
Integrate faster with SDKs and code samples.
